column1: # Number-word idioms that ITN must leave as words (one per line; Turkish lower-case; '#' = comment).
# These are not quantities: "üç beş kişi" is "a few people", "bin bir zahmetle" is "with countless troubles".
# A trailing '*' lets Turkish suffixes attach to the last word ("bin bir gece*" also keeps "bin bir gecede").
# A trailing '+' requires a following non-number word: "üç beş kişi" stays, but digit-by-digit dictation
# ("sıfır beş üç beş üç beş …") and times ("saat üç beş") still convert.
# The phrase must cover the whole idiom: plain "bin bir" and "bin bir lira" still convert (1.001, 1.001 TL).
